# Redis TCL Known Skips

# Redis Streams are outside the current compatibility surface. The adapter does
# not implement stream storage, stream consumer groups, or stream blocking
# timeout behavior, so stream-only assertions remain explicit skips.
Blocking commands ignores the timeout
COPY basic usage for stream
COPY basic usage for stream-cgroups

# Redis keyspace notification Pub/Sub is outside the current compatibility
# surface. Pub/Sub command delivery is implemented, but Redis keyspace event
# notification fanout for data mutations is not claimed.
/^Keyspace notifications:
SMOVE only notify dstset when the addition is successful
